name: components/markdown
description: A markdown rendering component with a plugin architecture and plugin packs for diagrams, Vega charts, Vega-Lite charts, syntax highlighting, copy actions, math, chemistry notation, TOC, annotations, task lists, containers, and sanitizer flows.
useCases: Render user-authored markdown content with consistent shadcn styling
Attach enhancement plugins such as code copy, diagram rendering, and data visualization
Display technical docs that include code fences and math formulas
Render chemistry-focused notes with SMILES notation support
